description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Overflow Fire Radiant Shield: 75%], [Critical Damage +50%], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Power Throw Counter Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Overflow Fire Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Fire damage capped at 99999

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Power Throw Counter Mode
description.text: Grants [Overflow Fire Radiant Shield: 125%]/[Overflow Fire Radiant Shield: 200%]/[Overflow Fire Radiant Shield: 300%] after using 1/2/3+ Fire abilities
